insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Noggin Boss delivered $412 in total sales for Week 46, up 79.6% from $229 the prior week, on 5 units. Sales were spread across five oversized hat styles, led by the Powder Blue, Royal L/XL and Plain Grey hats at $85 each, with the Plain Grey hat up 6.9%. Sunday, Nov 8 was the peak day at $251.

**Metrics to Watch —** Sales landed on Sun Nov 8 ($251), Thu Nov 12 ($74) and Sat Nov 14 ($85), with the other days at $0, so building steadier daily volume is the focus. Organic sales were $32 (-85.7% WoW) as paid traffic drove most orders, and the Plain Grey hat converted at 11.1% (-22.2%) on 9 sessions.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Ad spend of $210 (prior $15) generated $379 in PPC revenue for a 1.81x ROAS and 55.4% ACOS, with TACoS at 51.0%. Ads drove the bulk of this week's growth on a 0.37% ad CTR and 2.35% ad conversion, and we are now tightening targeting to bring ACOS down while keeping the momentum.

**Actions This Week —** We will shift budget toward the search terms and hat styles that converted, such as the Royal S/M hat at 7.7% CVR and the Powder Blue hat at 6.7%, and add negative keywords on non-converting traffic. We will also test new Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands ad creative to lift the 0.37% ad CTR as we head into the holiday season.
